title: Agent Spawn Failure Policy
description: Classification and handling protocol for agent spawn failures. Defines retry/replacement rules, failure exclusion from success counts, Main Agent fallback detection, and undeclared fallback prohibition.

spawnFailureClassification.description: Failures are classified by severity and remediability. Classification determines retry eligibility and whether the failure counts against phase success metrics.

classes.label: Transient Failure
classes.description: Failure caused by temporary environmental condition (network timeout, resource contention, temporary filesystem lock).
examples: Temporary file lock on registry write.

classes.label: Configuration Failure
classes.description: Failure caused by incorrect or missing configuration (invalid worker contract, missing required fields, scope path not found).
examples: Scope directory does not exist on filesystem.

classes.label: Permanent Failure
classes.description: Failure that cannot be resolved by retry or configuration fix. Requires alternative approach or human intervention.
examples: Agent capability not available in current runtime.
Irreconcilable contract conflict with existing worker.

classes.label: Undeclared Fallback
classes.description: Main Agent executed worker-scope work without a declared spawn failure. This is a policy violation, not a technical failure.
classes.detection: Cross-check file modification timestamps in worker-owned directories against Main Agent session. If Main Agent wrote to worker scope without a declared spawn failure, this violation triggers.
examples: Main Agent wrote to worker ownedFiles without spawn record.
Main Agent created artifacts in worker ownedDirectories without worker spawn.
Fallback work done by Main Agent with no AGENT_REGISTRY entry.

rules.description: Each failure class has a maximum retry count. TRANSIENT: 3, CONFIGURATION: 1, PERMANENT: 0, UNDECLARED_FALLBACK: 0.
rules.tracking: Retry count is tracked per agentId per phase.

rules.description: TRANSIENT failures use exponential backoff (5s, 10s, 20s). CONFIGURATION failures retry immediately after fix.
When maxRetries is exhausted for TRANSIENT or CONFIGURATION, the failure is escalated to PERMANENT.
rules.action: Record in AGENT_REGISTRY with status: spawn_failed_permanent.

rules.description: On PERMANENT failure, a replacement agent may be spawned with a different agentId and identical contract scope.
constraints: Replacement agent must have a distinct agentId.
Replacement agent inherits the failed agent's scope, dependencies, and handoff path.
Failed agent is recorded as excluded from success counts.
Replacement agent's contract must reference the replaced agentId.

failedAgentExclusion.description: Failed agents are excluded from phase success metrics.

rules.description: Agents with PERMANENT or UNDECLARED_FALLBACK failure status do not count toward phase completion success metrics.
rules.tracking: factoryctl phase-status excludes agents with status spawn_failed_permanent or fallback_detected.

rules.description: Failed agents are excluded from the numerator and denominator of agent completion ratio calculations.
A successful replacement agent counts toward completion. The failed agent it replaces does not.
rules.constraint: A replacement must complete successfully for its scope to be considered covered.

mainAgentFallbackDetection.description: Detection and handling of undeclared Main Agent fallback into worker scope.

detectionMethods.description: Check file modification timestamps in worker-owned directories. If any file was modified outside a worker session window, flag for investigation.
For every file in worker ownedDirectories, verify an AGENT_REGISTRY entry exists for the agent that created it.
Verify no agent wrote to files outside its contract scope.ownedFiles and scope.ownedDirectories.

violationHandling.action: Block phase closure. Require explicit declaration or re-spawn of work.
remediation: Option A: Declare the fallback retroactively (creates retroactive contract, nativeGenerated:false).
Option B: Re-spawn a proper worker to redo the work natively (nativeGenerated:true).
Option C: Exclude the affected scope from this phase and defer to next phase.

undeclaredFallbackProhibition.description: Main Agent must not perform worker-scope work without a declared spawn failure and AGENT_REGISTRY entry.

rules.description: If a spawn fails and Main Agent performs the work instead, this must be explicitly recorded as a spawn failure with class UNDECLARED_FALLBACK (or declared as a conscious fallback with registry entry).

If Main Agent declares a fallback BEFORE performing worker-scope work, and creates an AGENT_REGISTRY entry with status 'fallback_main_agent', this is allowed but the resulting artifacts are marked nativeGenerated:false.
rules.constraint: Declared fallback must be recorded before any file writes in the worker scope.

rules.description: Fallback cannot be declared after work is already done. This is equivalent to undeclared fallback.
